A1p.idea: domino: three spinners in a row turn each other as they leave - the order of departures decides every direction

D1p.idea: silent gate: the spinner beside the gate must leave through it unturned - any neighbour leaving first turns it into a deadlock

J1.idea: pull into parity: a magnet pulls an alternating spinner into a three-neighbour slot - the parity of turns after the pull decides its exit

E3.idea: pull away: a magnet pulls a spinner out of a neighbourhood whose departures would turn it the wrong way

G1.idea: advances on a rhythm: two Sequence blocks advance next to a pattern spinner - each advance moves its cw-cw-ccw cycle on

H1.idea: alternating chain: two adjacent alternating spinners turn each other back and forth

B2b.idea: parity key: the only purple key is an alternating spinner; it must leave after the right parity of turns to unlock

C2b.idea: count the pattern: the pattern spinner (cw, cw, ccw) is surrounded by three leavers; which neighbours leave before it decides its facing - only one count lets it out
